paragraphs: Join me for a free webinar:
Get better baby sleep: The Sleep Concierge’s successful sleep training method for parents of babies 4 months plus.
It’s live on Wednesday Oct 7, 2026 at 11 am AEDT (GMT+11). Allow 50 minutes: 35 minutes of teaching, 5 minutes about Camp Snooze and 10 minutes for your questions.

I’ve helped thousands of families around the world. In this session, I’ll explain how the daytime routine connects to overnight sleep, where sleep training fits and how to approach changes with a clear plan. I’ll also introduce Camp Snooze, which starts Monday Oct 19, 2026, and explain the support available as you put the plan into practice.
Register below to receive your joining details.
